steps.name: workspace-rejects-unknown-subcommand
steps.stdout:
A workspace is a content-addressed snapshot of a directory tree —
manifest plus zstd chunks, sha256-addressed. `daft workspace
serve` exposes one over mTLS for any approved peer to pull;
`daft workspace pull` reconstructs it at a destination.

Both sides share the daft client identity + peer store under
$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/daft/client/. See `daft auth show` to find
this peer's fingerprint.

Usage:
  daft workspace [command]

Available Commands:
  acquire          Acquire (or refresh) the workspace's write lock
  changes          Manage unadopted sandbox workspace changes
  create           Create a new workspace (name defaults to basename of cwd)
  debug            Low-level content-addressed transfer + diagnostics (advanced)
  delete           Permanently delete a stopped workspace and its retained data
  devcontainer     Set the path to a devcontainer.json within the workspace content (auto-detects the convention when no path is given)
  env              Manage workspace environment variables (add | rm)
  exec             Run a command inside a workspace's container with an interactive PTY
  forward          Forward a local TCP port through the orchestrator into a workspace
  get              Print a workspace config value (bare: print all)
  image            Set the workspace's OCI image reference (or clear it with --clear)
  launch           Dispatch the workspace to its pinned sandbox-host
  list             List workspaces registered with the orchestrator
  mount            Map a local directory to an in-VM path (no args: list mappings)
  nested           Enable/disable nested virtualisation (--enable binds /dev/kvm into the container)
  port             Manage workspace port mappings (add | rm)
  privileged-build Enable/disable the build capability grant (--enable gives the standard container cap set for in-sandbox image builds)
  privileged-fuse  Enable/disable privileged FUSE mounts (--enable grants CAP_SYS_ADMIN + /dev/fuse)
  pull             Pull recorded dir-local mounts down from the workspace's node CAS
  push             Push recorded dir-local mounts up to the workspace's node CAS
  release          Release the workspace's write lock
  resources        Set the workspace VM's RAM (--memory 4G) and/or vCPUs (--cpus N)
  set              Set a workspace config value
  status           Show the workspace's current state and missing fields
  stop             Stop the running workspace
  storage          Inspect the target node's workspace CAS
  target           Pin the workspace to a specific sandbox-host (or clear with no arg)
  unfreeze         Explicitly resume a storage-frozen workspace after remediation
  up               Launch a workspace and auto-open its devcontainer forwardPorts
  validate         Recompute readiness; auto-promote DRAFT → READY when all fields are set

Flags:
  -h, --help   help for workspace

Global Flags:
  -v, --verbose   enable verbose output (env: DAFT_VERBOSE)

Use "daft workspace [command] --help" for more information about a command.

steps.name: auth-rejects-unknown-subcommand
steps.stdout:
daft authenticates orchestrators and sandbox-hosts via mutual TLS
with TOFU peer pinning. The local identity (Ed25519 keypair +
self-signed leaf cert) plus the approved-peer set live under
$XDG_CONFIG_HOME/daft/client/ by default.

Approve a peer with `daft auth approve <fingerprint>` after
obtaining its fingerprint out-of-band; revoke with `daft auth
remove <fingerprint>`.

Usage:
  daft auth [command]

Available Commands:
  approve     Approve a peer by fingerprint (TOFU)
  list        List approved peers
  remove      Remove an approved peer
  show        Print this client's fingerprint and config dir

Flags:
      --config-dir string   override the daft client config dir (default: $XDG_CONFIG_HOME/daft/client)
  -h, --help                help for auth

Global Flags:
  -v, --verbose   enable verbose output (env: DAFT_VERBOSE)

Use "daft auth [command] --help" for more information about a command.
